tasks.title: Add validateTaskDependencies() function to ralph-executor.ts
tasks.description: Add a standalone validateTaskDependencies() function that checks: (1) every dependsOn ID exists in the task list, (2) no cycles in the dependency graph via DFS, (3) every dependsOn entry references a task with a strictly lower order value. Return validation result with descriptive error messages.
acceptanceCriteria: validateTaskDependencies() is exported from ralph-executor.ts
Returns { valid: true } for a valid dependency graph
Returns { valid: false, errors: string[] } with descriptive messages for invalid references, cycles, and forward dependencies
Tasks with dependsOn: [] or missing dependsOn pass validation
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Make findNextPendingTask() respect dependsOn and add deadlock detection
tasks.description: Modify findNextPendingTask() to only select tasks whose dependsOn tasks have all passed, using order as tie-breaker. Call validateTaskDependencies() at the top of runRalphLoop() and return a failed result on validation failure. Add deadlock detection: when no task is ready but pending tasks remain, return a failed result with pauseReason explaining the deadlock.
acceptanceCriteria: findNextPendingTask() skips tasks whose dependsOn tasks have not all passed
When multiple tasks are ready, the one with lowest order is selected
runRalphLoop() calls validateTaskDependencies() before the while-loop and returns failed result on validation error
Deadlock is detected when pending tasks exist but none are ready, logged as warning with descriptive pauseReason
Existing tests continue to pass (backward compatible with tasks having no dependsOn)
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Strengthen task generation prompt with dependency analysis instructions
tasks.description: Enhance tasks.md prompt: add an explicit 'Dependency Analysis' section instructing the agent to analyze dependencies between every pair of tasks, fill dependsOn for every non-first task, and add a second example showing multi-dependency chains. Also update self-review.md to add an explicit checklist item for dependency completeness and update planner-self-review.yaml feasibility section with dependency validation criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: tasks.md has a 'Dependency Analysis' section with step-by-step instructions
tasks.md includes a second example with multi-level dependency chain
self-review.md has explicit checklist item: every non-first task has at least one dependsOn entry
planner-self-review.yaml has dependency completeness criterion under feasibility
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prompt changes are independent of executor changes — can be done in parallel with T-001/T-002

tasks.title: Add unit tests for validateTaskDependencies, dependency-aware scheduling, and deadlock detection
tasks.description: Add tests to ralph-executor.test.ts covering: valid dependency graph passes, unknown reference fails, cycle detection, forward dependency detection, empty dependsOn is valid, findNextPendingTask respects deps, multiple ready tasks tie-breaking, deadlock detection when all pending tasks are blocked, and runRalphLoop rejects invalid graph on load.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover all 5 validation scenarios from the spec
Tests cover dependency-aware task selection (blocked task skipped, multiple ready tasks, deadlock)
Tests cover runRalphLoop early exit on validation failure
All existing tests continue to pass
Typecheck passes
